name: Wardwizard Foods and Beverages Limited
about: Wardwizard Foods and Beverages Limited manufactures and sells ready-to-eat (RTE) products, frozen food items, beverages, spices, and condiments in India. It operates through Sale of RTE, Frozen Foods; Food Commodities; and Services segments. The company offers ready-to-eat-food, including aloo mutter, chana masala, palak paneer, kadhi pakodi, baigan bhartha, mutter paneer, dal makhani, and paneer butter masala; and frozen food products, such as pizza punjabi samosa, bombay vada tikki, sabudana wada, veg spring roll, and lilva kachori. It also provides beverages comprising various pure drinking water; flavored drinks, such as lemon, cola, jeera, mojito, blue lagoon, orange, and ginger-lemon; and energy drink products. In addition, it offers spices products, including kanda lasun masala, garam masala, tandoori masala, meat masala, dhaniya powder, kitchen king masala, shahi paneer masala, chat masala, shahi biryani masala, haldi powder, sambar masala, pav bhaji masala, chicken masala, kashmiri chilli masala, chole masala, sabji masala, panipuri masala, and mirchi powder; and condiments consisting of tandoori and classic mayonnaise, salad mayonnaise, pizza pasta sauces, tomato sauces, cheese blends, green and red chilli sauces, dark soya sauces, tomato ketchup, and schezwan chutney. Further, it operates quick-service restaurants. The company offers its products under the QuikShef and Water of Life brands through retail outlets. The company exports its products to the United States, Canada, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, Bahrain, Germany, Tanzania, and Australia. The company was formerly known as Vegetable Products Limited and changed its name to Wardwizard Foods and Beverages Limited in August 2022. Wardwizard Foods and Beverages Limited was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in Vadodara, India.
